🏙️ The City of London gives lots of opportunities to It's citizens.

In this game, you can become anything your heart desires.
You can become a Police Officer, a working business man , a criminal mastermind or just a regular citizen and countless others!

This game can be used to seek the thrill of stealing huge amounts of cash, making business deals
and getting opportunities to work at tons of different occupations. And the thrill of next level combat system.
